title: Followers
description: Everyone who can travel with you: where to find them, how to recruit, marriage, skills and level cap.

items.title: Lydia
items.location: Whiterun — Dragonsreach (Breezehome once you buy it)
items.description: Whiterun housecarl and usually the hero's first follower. Jarl Balgruuf the Greater assigns her after Dragon Rising, when he makes you a thane.

facts.label: How to recruit
facts.value: Become Thane of Whiterun by completing Dragon Rising (no house purchase needed)

facts.label: Combat style
facts.value: Warrior: steel sword and shield, hunting bow as backup

facts.label: Marriage
facts.value: yes — wear an Amulet of Mara (talk to Maramal in Riften first)

tips: If you buy Breezehome, Lydia moves there and waits for you at home.
With the Dragonborn add-on she gains unique lines on Solstheim.

items.title: Argis the Bulwark
items.description: Housecarl of the Reach. He appears in Vlindrel Hall once you become Thane of the Reach.

facts.label: How to recruit
facts.value: Become Thane of the Reach: do a task for Jarl Igmund, help the people of the hold and buy Vlindrel Hall

facts.label: Marriage
facts.value: yes — wear an Amulet of Mara (talk to Maramal in Riften first)

tips: At level 50 Argis has 100 Block, Heavy Armor and One-handed, one of the toughest housecarls.
With Hearthfire he is the only housecarl who cannot become a steward.

items.title: Calder
items.description: Housecarl of Eastmarch. He appears in Hjerim once you become Thane of Eastmarch.

facts.label: How to recruit
facts.value: Become Thane of Eastmarch and buy Hjerim. Under Jarl Ulfric: Rescue from Fort Neugrad and Blood on the Ice; under Brunwulf: Battle for Windhelm

facts.label: Combat style
facts.value: Warrior: steel war axe and shield

facts.label: Marriage
facts.value: yes — wear an Amulet of Mara (talk to Maramal in Riften first)

tips: You cannot become Thane of Eastmarch without picking a side in the Civil War.

items.title: Iona
items.description: Housecarl of the Rift. She appears in Honeyside as soon as you become Thane of the Rift.

facts.label: How to recruit
facts.value: Become Thane of the Rift: Supply and Demand, help the people of the hold and buy Honeyside

facts.label: Combat style
facts.value: Warrior: steel war axe and shield

facts.label: Marriage
facts.value: yes — wear an Amulet of Mara (talk to Maramal in Riften first)

tips: Known bug: Iona sometimes dies in normal combat even though she should be protected like other followers.

items.title: Jordis the Sword-Maiden
items.description: Housecarl of Haafingar. She appears in Proudspire Manor once you become Thane of Haafingar.

facts.label: How to recruit
facts.value: Become Thane of Haafingar: Elisif's Tribute, help the people of the hold and buy Proudspire Manor

facts.label: Marriage
facts.value: yes — wear an Amulet of Mara (talk to Maramal in Riften first)

tips: Elisif stays Jarl of Haafingar whatever happens in the Civil War, so Jordis is available on either side.

items.title: Aela the Huntress
items.description: A huntress and member of the Companions' Circle, central to their questline. She becomes a follower after Glory of the Dead.

facts.label: How to recruit
facts.value: Finish the Companions questline (Glory of the Dead), then ask in Jorrvaskr

facts.label: Combat style
facts.value: Archer: hunting bow and Skyforge steel dagger

facts.label: Marriage
facts.value: yes — wear an Amulet of Mara (talk to Maramal in Riften first), after the Companions questline

tips: The only Circle member who does not cure her lycanthropy after the questline.
She is essential only until Glory of the Dead is done; after that she is a normal follower.

items.title: Athis
items.description: A Dunmer warrior of the Companions who prefers short blades. He becomes a follower after the Companions questline.

facts.label: How to recruit
facts.value: Finish the Companions questline (Glory of the Dead), then ask in Jorrvaskr

facts.label: Combat style
facts.value: Warrior: Skyforge steel sword and shield

facts.label: Marriage
facts.value: yes — wear an Amulet of Mara (talk to Maramal in Riften first), after the Companions questline

tips: On your first visit to Jorrvaskr he is brawling with Njada, and he always loses.

items.title: Farkas
items.description: A member of the Companions' Circle, a werewolf and Vilkas's twin brother. He becomes a follower after Glory of the Dead.

facts.label: How to recruit
facts.value: Finish the Companions questline (Glory of the Dead), then ask in Jorrvaskr

facts.label: Combat style
facts.value: Warrior: Skyforge steel greatsword, heavy armor

facts.label: Marriage
facts.value: yes — wear an Amulet of Mara (talk to Maramal in Riften first), after the Companions questline

tips: After Proving Honor he is afraid of spiders and will not go past the outer chambers of Ysgramor's Tomb.
"Farkas" means "wolf" in Hungarian.
He is essential only until Glory of the Dead is done.

items.title: Njada Stonearm
items.description: An unsociable Companions warrior and shield specialist. She agrees to follow you once you become Harbinger.

facts.label: How to recruit
facts.value: Finish the Companions questline (Glory of the Dead), then ask in Jorrvaskr

facts.label: Combat style
facts.value: Warrior: Skyforge steel sword and steel shield, bow as backup

facts.label: Marriage
facts.value: yes — wear an Amulet of Mara (talk to Maramal in Riften first), after the Companions questline

tips: Her health is low for a warrior, so give her gear enchanted with Fortify Health.

items.title: Ria
items.description: An Imperial, the newest Companion before you arrive, eager to die an honorable death. She becomes a follower after the Companions questline.

facts.label: How to recruit
facts.value: Finish the Companions questline (Glory of the Dead), then ask in Jorrvaskr

facts.label: Combat style
facts.value: Warrior: Skyforge steel sword and steel shield

facts.label: Marriage
facts.value: yes — wear an Amulet of Mara (talk to Maramal in Riften first), after the Companions questline

tips: You can first meet her at Pelagia Farm, where the Companions fight a giant.
Her default scaled armor is light, but she is better with heavy armor, so give her a heavy set.

items.title: Torvar
items.description: The drunken misfit of the Companions who grows colder towards you as you rise. He still becomes a follower after the questline.

facts.label: How to recruit
facts.value: Finish the Companions questline (Glory of the Dead), then ask in Jorrvaskr

facts.label: Combat style
facts.value: Warrior: Skyforge steel sword and steel shield

facts.label: Marriage
facts.value: yes — wear an Amulet of Mara (talk to Maramal in Riften first), after the Companions questline

tips: He brags about loving hammers and axes, yet carries a sword and wears leather, though he is better in heavy armor.

items.title: Vilkas
items.description: A member of the Companions' Circle, a werewolf and Farkas's twin brother. He becomes a follower after Glory of the Dead.

facts.label: How to recruit
facts.value: Finish the Companions questline (Glory of the Dead), then ask in Jorrvaskr

facts.label: Marriage
facts.value: yes — wear an Amulet of Mara (talk to Maramal in Riften first), after the Companions questline

tips: "Vilkas" means "wolf" in Lithuanian.
He is essential only until Glory of the Dead is done.

items.title: Belrand
items.description: A Nord sellsword who mixes blade and magic. He sits in the Winking Skeever and follows you for 500 gold.

facts.label: How to recruit
facts.value: Hire him at the Winking Skeever

facts.label: Marriage
facts.value: yes — wear an Amulet of Mara (talk to Maramal in Riften first), after hiring at least once

tips: If you ask him again soon after dismissing him, he may rejoin for free.
He heals himself and casts wards, a good pick for a hero without healing magic.

items.title: Erik the Slayer
items.description: Son of innkeeper Mralki who dreams of adventure. After his quest he becomes a mercenary you can hire for 500 gold.

facts.label: How to recruit
facts.value: Complete the quest Erik the Slayer (convince Mralki), then come back later and hire him

tips: Mralki can be persuaded, intimidated or simply paid for the armor.
As a mercenary Erik gets iron armor and a shield, yet never actually leaves the inn to adventure.

items.title: Jenassa
items.description: A Dunmer ranger sitting at a table in the Drunken Huntsman. She can be hired for 500 gold.

facts.label: How to recruit
facts.value: Hire her at the Drunken Huntsman

facts.label: Combat style
facts.value: Ranger: hunting bow, dual-wields sword and dagger up close

facts.label: Marriage
facts.value: yes — wear an Amulet of Mara (talk to Maramal in Riften first), after hiring at least once

tips: One of the few followers who dual-wield blades.
If she vanishes after a visit to Jorrvaskr, check the Dragonsreach dungeon.

items.title: Marcurio
items.description: An Imperial mercenary mage specialising in Destruction. He can be hired for 500 gold.

facts.label: How to recruit
facts.value: Hire him at the Bee and Barb

facts.label: Combat style
facts.value: Destruction mage: lightning and fire, can use staves

facts.label: Marriage
facts.value: yes — wear an Amulet of Mara (talk to Maramal in Riften first), after hiring at least once

tips: Once married he follows you for free; he has no house, so he lives at the Bee and Barb.
If he is the mark in the Thieves Guild job The Fishing Job, it is easier to hire him and take the amulet by trading.

items.title: Stenvar
items.description: A Nord mercenary with a greatsword. He usually waits on the second floor of Candlehearth Hall and can be hired for 500 gold.

facts.label: Combat style
facts.value: Two-handed warrior in full steel armor

facts.label: Marriage
facts.value: yes — wear an Amulet of Mara (talk to Maramal in Riften first), after hiring at least once

tips: Due to a bug he never rejoins for free; it is 500 gold every time (fixed by the Unofficial Patch).
items.missable: Bug: if Stenvar is forcibly dismissed by the Companions questline (they take the follower slot), he may vanish and never return to Candlehearth Hall. Dismiss him beforehand.

items.title: Vorstag
items.description: A Nord mercenary at the Silver-Blood Inn, equally good with a bow and in melee. He can be hired for 500 gold.

facts.label: How to recruit
facts.value: Hire him at the Silver-Blood Inn

facts.label: Combat style
facts.value: Warrior: iron war axe and shield, bow

facts.label: Marriage
facts.value: yes — wear an Amulet of Mara (talk to Maramal in Riften first), after hiring at least once

tips: He hates mines but keeps marvelling at Dwemer ruins.
He wears light armor but is better with heavy armor, so give him a heavy set.

items.title: Brelyna Maryon
items.description: A Dunmer student at the College of Winterhold. She becomes a follower after you help her in Brelyna's Practice.

facts.label: How to recruit
facts.value: After Under Saarthal, complete Brelyna's Practice

facts.label: Combat style
facts.value: Mystic: summons atronachs, casts wards and heals

facts.label: Marriage
facts.value: yes — wear an Amulet of Mara (talk to Maramal in Riften first), after her quest

tips: Her quest turns you green, then into a horse, a cow and a dog; the reward is a Resist Magic necklace.
Steal from the College too often while she follows you and she will eventually attack.

items.title: J'zargo
items.description: A cocky Khajiit student at the College of Winterhold. He becomes a follower after J'zargo's Experiment.

facts.label: How to recruit
facts.value: After Under Saarthal, complete J'zargo's Experiment: hit three undead with his scrolls

facts.label: Combat style
facts.value: Sorcerer: shock and fire spells, casts wards

facts.label: Max level
facts.value: no cap (30 with the Unofficial Patch)

tips: The only one of the three students who keeps leveling with you without a cap.
His Flame Cloak scrolls explode and hurt allies, so tell your follower to wait; you get no extra scrolls.

items.title: Onmund
items.description: A Nord student at the College of Winterhold, a rare Nord mage. He becomes a follower once you return his family amulet.

facts.label: How to recruit
facts.value: After Under Saarthal, complete Onmund's Request: get the amulet from Enthir for a staff or by persuasion

facts.label: Combat style
facts.value: Sorcerer: Chain Lightning and Lightning Bolt, ward, invisibility

facts.label: Marriage
facts.value: yes — wear an Amulet of Mara (talk to Maramal in Riften first), after his quest

tips: With high Speech you can persuade Enthir to hand over the amulet without fetching the staff.

items.title: Golldir
items.description: A Nord guarding his ancestors' tomb from a necromancer. Joins you after Ancestral Worship (kill Vals Veran).

facts.label: Combat style
facts.value: Warrior: one-handed weapon and shield, heavy armor

tips: After the quest he waits outside the tomb entrance.

items.title: Illia
items.description: An Imperial mage trying to stop her witch mother from becoming a hagraven. Becomes a follower after Repentance.

facts.label: Combat style
facts.value: Elemental mage: fire, frost and shock spells, healing

tips: One of the strongest mage followers; she favors frost spells.
When dismissed she returns to Darklight Tower.

items.title: Borgakh the Steel Heart
items.description: An Orc warrior who wants to leave her stronghold. Persuade her or pay her dowry — she can also be married.

facts.label: How to recruit
facts.value: Become Blood-Kin of the Orcs, then persuade her or pay her dowry (bribe)

facts.label: Combat style
facts.value: Warrior: one-handed weapon and shield, heavy armor

facts.label: Marriage
facts.value: Yes — wear an Amulet of Mara (The Bonds of Matrimony)

tips: You can take the dowry gold back from her inventory once she follows you.

items.title: Ghorbash the Iron Hand
items.description: Chief Burguk's brother and a former legionnaire who misses adventure. Joins after persuasion, a bribe or a brawl.

facts.label: How to recruit
facts.value: Blood-Kin, then persuade, bribe or out-brawl him

facts.label: Combat style
facts.value: Ranger: bow and one-handed weapon, light armor

facts.label: Marriage
facts.value: Yes — wear an Amulet of Mara (The Bonds of Matrimony)

items.title: Lob
items.description: An Orc smith's apprentice in cursed Largashbur. Becomes a follower once Malacath's curse is lifted.

facts.label: Combat style
facts.value: Ranger: bow and one-handed weapon, light armor

items.title: Ogol
items.description: An Orc of Largashbur who is hostile at first. After The Cursed Tribe he respects you enough to follow.

facts.label: Combat style
facts.value: Warrior: one-handed weapon and shield, heavy armor

tips: He wears only clothes — give him heavy armor right away.

items.title: Ugor
items.description: An Orc warrior of Largashbur, first met fighting a giant at the gate. Becomes a follower after The Cursed Tribe.

facts.label: Combat style
facts.value: Ranger: bow and one-handed weapon, light armor

tips: Help her against the giant at the gate — she can die before the quest even starts.

items.title: Adelaisa Vendicci
items.description: An East Empire Company officer who joins the assault on the Blood Horker pirates. Becomes a follower after Rise in the East.

facts.label: Combat style
facts.value: Generalist: melee and bow, no real specialty

tips: She is essential only until her quest ends.

items.title: Ahtar
items.description: Solitude's headsman and jailer who let a prisoner escape. Kill the escapee and he becomes a follower.

facts.label: How to recruit
facts.value: Complete his Kill the Bandit Leader favor

tips: Only one Kill the Bandit Leader quest can be active at a time.

items.title: Annekke Crag-Jumper
items.description: A retired adventurer who misses the road. After you kill a bandit leader for her, she will join you.

facts.label: How to recruit
facts.value: Complete her Kill the Bandit Leader favor

facts.label: Combat style
facts.value: Ranger: bow and one-handed weapon, light armor

facts.label: Marriage
facts.value: No — she is married to Verner

items.title: Aranea Ienith
items.description: A priestess of Azura and a strong elemental mage. Joins you if you return the star to Azura rather than Nelacar in The Black Star.

facts.label: How to recruit
facts.value: Finish The Black Star in Azura's favor

facts.label: Combat style
facts.value: Elemental mage: fire, frost and shock spells, healing

facts.label: Morality
facts.value: Will commit any crime you order

items.missable: If you give the star to Nelacar (The Black Star), Aranea turns hostile.

items.title: Benor
items.description: A boastful Nord warrior of Morthal. Beat him in a 100-gold brawl and he becomes a follower.

facts.label: Marriage
facts.value: Yes — wear an Amulet of Mara (The Bonds of Matrimony)

facts.label: Morality
facts.value: Will commit any crime you order

items.title: Cosnach
items.description: A hard-drinking Breton warrior at the Silver-Blood Inn. Buy him a drink or win his brawl and he will follow you.

facts.label: How to recruit
facts.value: Give him any alcohol (Quest all Drunks Have) or win his brawl

facts.label: Combat style
facts.value: Warrior: one-handed weapon and shield, heavy armor

facts.label: Marriage
facts.value: Yes — wear an Amulet of Mara (The Bonds of Matrimony)

tips: The quickest follower in Markarth — one bottle of mead is enough.

items.title: Derkeethus
items.description: An Argonian miner held captive by the Falmer. Rescue him in Darkwater Pass and he becomes a follower and marriage candidate.

facts.label: Combat style
facts.value: Ranger: bow and one-handed weapon, light armor

facts.label: Marriage
facts.value: Yes — wear an Amulet of Mara (The Bonds of Matrimony)

tips: The only follower with unlimited breath underwater.
He is essential because of a game bug.

items.title: Eola
items.location: Markarth Hall of the Dead; Reachcliff Cave
items.description: A Breton cannibal devoted to Namira. Joins you if you finish The Taste of Death on her side.

facts.label: How to recruit
facts.value: Finish The Taste of Death as Namira's champion

facts.label: Combat style
facts.value: Nightblade: fire spells and a sword

facts.label: Morality
facts.value: Will commit any crime you order

items.missable: Lost if you refuse Namira in The Taste of Death and kill her.

items.title: Erandur
items.description: A Dunmer priest of Mara and former Vaermina cultist. If you let him destroy the Skull of Corruption in Waking Nightmare, he becomes a follower.

facts.label: How to recruit
facts.value: Finish Waking Nightmare without killing him

facts.label: Combat style
facts.value: Priest: mace, fire spells and wards

items.missable: Killing him for the Skull of Corruption at Vaermina's urging loses him forever.

items.title: Faendal
items.description: A Wood Elf lumberjack and hunter, Sven's rival for Camilla. Side with him in A Lovely Letter and he will follow you.

facts.label: How to recruit
facts.value: Finish A Lovely Letter in his favor

facts.label: Combat style
facts.value: Ranger: bow and one-handed weapon, light armor

tips: Train Archery and take the gold back from his inventory (fixed by the Unofficial Patch).
items.missable: Only one of Faendal or Sven can be recruited.

items.title: Kharjo
items.description: A Khajiit caravan guard whose moon amulet was stolen by bandits. Return it and he joins you.

facts.label: Combat style
facts.value: Warrior: one-handed weapon and shield, heavy armor

tips: When dismissed he returns to the caravan, so look for him along its route.

items.title: Mjoll the Lioness
items.description: A retired adventurer fighting Riften's corruption. Recover her sword Grimsever from Mzinchaleft and she will follow you.

facts.label: Marriage
facts.value: Yes — wear an Amulet of Mara (The Bonds of Matrimony)

tips: You can take Grimsever back from her inventory while she follows you.
She is essential, which makes her a safe pick at any level.

items.title: Roggi Knot-Beard
items.description: A Nord miner and mead connoisseur in Kynesgrove. Find his ancestor's shield and he becomes a follower and marriage candidate.

facts.label: How to recruit
facts.value: Bring back his ancestor's shield (Dungeon Delving (Caves))

facts.label: Combat style
facts.value: Generalist: melee and bow, no real specialty

facts.label: Marriage
facts.value: Yes — wear an Amulet of Mara (The Bonds of Matrimony)

items.title: Sven
items.description: Riverwood's bard and Faendal's rival for Camilla. Side with him in A Lovely Letter and he will follow you.

facts.label: How to recruit
facts.value: Finish A Lovely Letter in his favor

facts.label: Combat style
facts.value: Generalist: melee and bow, no real specialty

items.missable: Only one of Sven or Faendal can be recruited.

items.title: Uthgerd the Unbroken
items.description: A Nord warrior at The Bannered Mare. Beat her in a 100-gold brawl and she becomes a follower and marriage candidate.

facts.label: Combat style
facts.value: Warrior: one-handed weapon and shield, heavy armor

facts.label: Marriage
facts.value: Yes — wear an Amulet of Mara (The Bonds of Matrimony)

tips: One of the earliest followers — available in Whiterun right at the start.

items.title: Serana
items.location: Dimhollow Crypt; then Volkihar Keep or Fort Dawnguard
items.description: A pure-blood vampire, Lord Harkon's daughter, found sealed in a sarcophagus. She travels with you through the Dawnguard story and stays a permanent follower after Kindred Judgment.

facts.label: How to recruit
facts.value: Free her in Awakening; permanent after Kindred Judgment

facts.label: Combat style
facts.value: Necromancer: raises corpses, vampiric drain, dagger

facts.label: Marriage
facts.value: No — she declines, though she reacts to an Amulet of Mara

tips: Has more unique dialogue than any other follower — places, quests and NPCs all get comments.
On the Dawnguard side you can convince her to be cured of vampirism by Falion after the finale.
After Kindred Judgment she can turn you into a Vampire Lord at any time.

items.title: Agmaer
items.description: A nervous Nord who wants to become a vampire hunter, met in Dayspring Canyon. Becomes a follower after Prophet.

facts.label: How to recruit
facts.value: Join the Dawnguard and complete Prophet

facts.label: Combat style
facts.value: Melee fighter: one- or two-handed weapons, light armor

items.missable: Unavailable if you side with the vampires — the Dawnguard is wiped out.

items.title: Beleval
items.description: A Wood Elf Dawnguard recruit who drills with the crossbow at the fort. Becomes a follower after Prophet.

facts.label: How to recruit
facts.value: Join the Dawnguard and complete Prophet

facts.label: Combat style
facts.value: Melee fighter: one- or two-handed weapons, light armor

items.missable: Unavailable if you side with the vampires — the Dawnguard is wiped out.

items.title: Celann
items.description: A Breton former Vigilant of Stendarr and Isran's old comrade. Becomes a follower after Prophet.

facts.label: How to recruit
facts.value: Join the Dawnguard and complete Prophet

facts.label: Combat style
facts.value: Warrior: one-handed weapon and shield, heavy armor

tips: One of the few followers with no level cap.
items.missable: Unavailable if you side with the vampires — the Dawnguard is wiped out.

items.title: Durak
items.description: An Orc vampire hunter who first invites you to join the Dawnguard. Becomes a follower after Prophet.

facts.label: How to recruit
facts.value: Join the Dawnguard and complete Prophet

facts.label: Combat style
facts.value: Ranger: crossbow, war axe and shield

tips: After Prophet he makes you Blood-Kin, opening every Orc stronghold.
No level cap.
items.missable: Unavailable if you side with the vampires — the Dawnguard is wiped out.

items.title: Ingjard
items.description: A Nord warrior who joined the Dawnguard. Becomes a follower after Prophet.

facts.label: How to recruit
facts.value: Join the Dawnguard and complete Prophet

tips: No level cap.
items.missable: Unavailable if you side with the vampires — the Dawnguard is wiped out.

items.title: Armored Troll
items.description: A Dawnguard war troll sold by Gunmar. From level 20 on he sells an Armored Frost Troll instead.

facts.label: How to recruit
facts.value: Buy one from Gunmar once he joins the fort (A New Order)

facts.label: Type
facts.value: Animal follower — wait and follow commands only

tips: A dismissed troll is gone for good — you have to buy another.
Regenerates health in combat but is weak to fire.
items.missable: Unavailable if you side with the vampires — the Dawnguard is wiped out.

items.title: Bran
items.description: An armored husky kept in the Fort Dawnguard pen. Available as an animal follower after A New Order.

facts.label: How to recruit
facts.value: Join the Dawnguard and complete A New Order

facts.label: Pet (Hearthfire)
facts.value: Yes — can become your child's pet

items.missable: Unavailable if you side with the vampires — the Dawnguard is wiped out.

items.title: Sceolang
items.description: The second armored husky in the Fort Dawnguard pen. Available as an animal follower after A New Order.

facts.label: How to recruit
facts.value: Join the Dawnguard and complete A New Order

facts.label: Pet (Hearthfire)
facts.value: Yes — can become your child's pet

items.missable: Unavailable if you side with the vampires — the Dawnguard is wiped out.

items.title: CuSith
items.description: A death hound of the Volkihar vampires. Becomes an animal follower if you join the clan.

facts.label: How to recruit
facts.value: Accept Harkon's gift and join the Volkihar Clan

tips: Stuck at level 5, so it falls behind quickly.
items.missable: Unavailable if you side with the Dawnguard.

items.title: Garmr
items.description: The second death hound of Volkihar Keep. Becomes an animal follower if you join the clan.

facts.label: How to recruit
facts.value: Accept Harkon's gift and join the Volkihar Clan

items.missable: Unavailable if you side with the Dawnguard.

items.title: Frea
items.description: The Skaal shaman's daughter who guides you through the Temple of Miraak. After The Fate of the Skaal she can be persuaded to follow you permanently.

facts.label: How to recruit
facts.value: Complete The Fate of the Skaal, then persuade her (Speech 25+)

facts.label: Combat style
facts.value: Warrior: two axes, flesh spells, healing

tips: Essential with no level cap — one of the strongest followers.
Comments on places and events of the Dragonborn story.

items.title: Teldryn Sero
items.description: A Dunmer sellsword in chitin armor who mixes blade and fire magic. Hire him for 500 gold.

facts.label: How to recruit
facts.value: Hire for 500 gold; rehiring is free

facts.label: Combat style
facts.value: Spellsword: sword, fire spells, Flame Atronach

facts.label: Morality
facts.value: Will commit any crime you order

tips: Plenty of witty lines about Solstheim and Morrowind.
Unlike mainland hirelings, he never asks to be paid again.

items.title: Talvas Fathryon
items.description: Neloth's apprentice, obsessed with summoning an ash guardian. After From the Ashes he agrees to travel with you.

facts.label: Combat style
facts.value: Conjurer: atronachs, fire and frost spells

tips: Sells spells, including Conjure Ash Guardian after his quest.

items.title: Ralis Sedarys
items.location: Kolbjorn Barrow; later The Retching Netch in Raven Rock
items.description: A Dunmer excavating Kolbjorn Barrow for the relics of Ahzidal. Spare him at the end of Unearthed and he moves to Raven Rock as a follower.

facts.label: How to recruit
facts.value: Spare him at the end of Unearthed

tips: With another follower active he offers no recruit dialogue — dismiss them first.
items.missable: Lost if you kill him at the end of Unearthed.

items.title: Riekling
items.description: The rieklings of Thirsk serve you once you become their chief. Choose a riekling, scout, hunter or warrior.

facts.label: How to recruit
facts.value: Become chief in The Chief of Thirsk Hall

facts.label: Type
facts.value: Creature follower: spear; the scout uses a bow

tips: Solstheim only — automatically leaves when you travel to Skyrim.
Thirsk riekling warriors sometimes appear at random to help you fight.
items.missable: Unavailable if you help Bujold's Nords in Retaking Thirsk.

items.title: Steadfast Dwarven Sphere
items.description: A friendly Dwemer automaton inside Kagrumez. Unlocked after the second stage of the Kagrumez Gauntlet.

facts.label: How to recruit
facts.value: Clear the second Kagrumez Gauntlet stage and talk to it

tips: Come at level 24+ to get the version with a ranged attack.
If destroyed it respawns in Kagrumez after a day.

items.title: Steadfast Dwarven Spider
items.description: A friendly Dwemer spider in Kagrumez, unlocked after the first trial. Weaker than the sphere but available sooner.

facts.label: How to recruit
facts.value: Clear the first Kagrumez Gauntlet stage and pull the lever

tips: Cannot follow you at the same time as a dog.

items.title: Meeko
items.description: A dog left alone after his owner died, near a shack south of Solitude. Just talk to him and he follows you.

facts.label: Pet (Hearthfire)
facts.value: Yes — introduce him to your child

tips: Look on the road south of the shack — he runs up to you.
Can follow you alongside a regular follower.

items.title: Vigilance
items.description: A war dog sold by Banning at the Markarth stables. The highest level cap of any dog.
tips: If dismissed he returns to Banning and you must pay again.
Charges ahead and often breaks your stealth.

items.title: Stray Dog
items.description: A dog fighting off two wolves or skeevers. If it survives, talk to it and it becomes a follower.

facts.label: How to recruit
facts.value: Save it in the random encounter and talk to it

tips: Easily lost when changing areas — make it a pet quickly.

items.title: Cicero
items.description: The mad jester and Keeper of the Night Mother. Spare him in The Cure for Madness and finish the Dark Brotherhood to recruit him.

facts.label: How to recruit
facts.value: Spare him in The Cure for Madness, finish Hail Sithis!

facts.label: Combat style
facts.value: Assassin: one-handed weapon and stealth, light armor

facts.label: Morality
facts.value: Will commit any crime you order

tips: Essential and will carry out any order, murder included.
Note: his jester outfit is only obtainable if you kill him instead.
items.missable: Lost if you kill him in The Cure for Madness or destroy the Dark Brotherhood.

items.title: Dark Brotherhood Initiate
items.description: Two Nord assassins (a man and a woman) who join the Brotherhood after its finale. Essential and level up to 100.

facts.label: How to recruit
facts.value: Finish Hail Sithis! and buy Sanctuary upgrades from Delvin Mallory

facts.label: Combat style
facts.value: Assassin: one-handed weapon and stealth, light armor

facts.label: Morality
facts.value: Will commit any crime you order

tips: The highest level cap of any essential follower.
They wear full Shrouded armor and carry an ebony dagger.
They have no arrows of their own — give them some for archery.
items.missable: Unavailable if you destroy the Dark Brotherhood.

items.title: Barbas
items.description: Clavicus Vile's talking dog. Follows you during A Daedra's Best Friend and cannot be harmed.

facts.label: Special
facts.value: Invulnerable; leaves when the quest ends

tips: Leave the quest unfinished and invulnerable Barbas will fight beside you indefinitely.
Only the Rueful Axe can hurt him.

items.title: Gregor
items.description: A Nord housecarl granted by the Jarl of the Pale when you become thane. Guards Heljarchen Hall.

facts.label: How to recruit
facts.value: Become Thane of the Pale (requires Hearthfire)

facts.label: Combat style
facts.value: Warrior: one-handed weapon and shield, heavy armor

facts.label: Marriage
facts.value: Yes — wear an Amulet of Mara (The Bonds of Matrimony)

facts.label: Morality
facts.value: Will commit any crime you order

tips: Guards your Hearthfire homestead while not following you.

items.title: Rayya
items.location: Falkreath, Jarl's Longhouse; later Lakeview Manor
items.description: A Redguard housecarl granted by the Jarl of Falkreath when you become thane. Guards Lakeview Manor.

facts.label: Combat style
facts.value: Warrior: one-handed, often dual-wielding; heavy armor

facts.label: Marriage
facts.value: Yes — wear an Amulet of Mara (The Bonds of Matrimony)

facts.label: Morality
facts.value: Will commit any crime you order

tips: Guards your Hearthfire homestead while not following you.

items.title: Valdimar
items.description: A Nord housecarl granted by the Jarl of Hjaalmarch when you become thane. The only mage housecarl — he fights in melee once out of magicka.

facts.label: Combat style
facts.value: Sorcerer: Destruction spells, healing, one-handed weapon

facts.label: Marriage
facts.value: Yes — wear an Amulet of Mara (The Bonds of Matrimony)

facts.label: Morality
facts.value: Will commit any crime you order

tips: Guards your Hearthfire homestead while not following you.
